source: CDC / AASM recommended sleep by age (6–12: 9–12 h, 13–18: 8–10 h, 18+: 7–9 h); bedtime = wake at 7 AM. Rules: C-TODD-1..4, G01 G03 G04 G05 G07 G08 G11 G19
title: SLEEP TO GROW
subtitle: HOURS · BEDTIME · BY AGE
voice: High-energy TikTok fitness creator talking straight to camera: upbeat, punchy, fast, big smile in the voice, stress the key words, short snappy pauses.
intro: Still growing? Here's how much you should sleep at your age.

rows.say: Ten. Ten to twelve hours. Lights out at eight.
Twelve. Nine to twelve. Your body does a lot of its growing while you sleep.
Fourteen. Nine to ten. This is often your fastest year of growth.
Fifteen. Eight to ten. Bed by ten.
Sixteen. Eight to ten. Phone off, not just face down.
Eighteen. Seven to nine. Good sleep helps you stand tall.

outro: And you? Comment your age, height and bedtime.
